How to read this page. Usage counts are distinct (wiki, page ID) pairs from Commons GlobalUsage; repeated embeds on one page count once. Collection used multiple API requests, so counts may have changed during collection or since.

Coverage is inferred from Commons categories, file descriptions, and filenames; it is not a geospatial validation. “Invalid SVG” and broken-link categories are Commons flags, while HTTP 429 means a preview request was rate-limited. Source category · GlobalUsage API

The catalog is embedded in this HTML. No local server or external scripts are needed; Commons links open only when selected.
